verdict.rationale: Stripe Atlas is an incorporation and compliance service, so a programmatic API or webhook for entity standing and filing deadlines is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows only human-facing features: filing reminders, an onboarding checklist, emails and a registered agent. Nothing documents an Atlas API or registrable outbound webhooks an agent could use to watch deadlines, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can watch entity standing and filing deadlines through an API or webhook and raise them before they lapse
